AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

ChainId.description: Unique identifier of the chain. Required when using [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property), ignored otherwise.

Name.title: String update value
Name.description: Name of the company (or `null` if the name should not be updated).

MotherCompanyId.title: Guid update value
MotherCompanyId.description: Unique identifier of the mother company (or `null` if the mother company should not be updated).

InvoicingEmail.title: String update value
InvoicingEmail.description: Email for issuing invoices to the company  (or `null` if the email for issuing invoices should not be updated).

WebsiteUrl.title: String update value
WebsiteUrl.description: The website url of the company (or `null` if the website url should not be updated).

InvoiceDueInterval.title: String update value
InvoiceDueInterval.description: The maximum time, when the invoice has to be be paid in ISO 8601 duration format (or `null` if the interval should not be updated).

Options.title: Company update options
Options.description: Options of the company (or `null` if the company options should not be updated).

CreditRating.title: Credit rating update parameters
CreditRating.description: Credit rating to define creditworthiness of the company (or `null` if the credit rating should not be updated).

Department.title: String update value
Department.description: The internal segmentation of a company, e.g. sales department (or `null` if the department should not be updated).

DunsNumber.title: String update value
DunsNumber.description: The Dun & Bradstreet unique 9-digit DUNS number (or `null` if the Duns number should not be updated).

ReferenceIdentifier.title: String update value
ReferenceIdentifier.description: External system identifier - custom identifier used by an external system such as an external database (or `null` if the identifier should not be updated).

AccountingCode.title: String update value
AccountingCode.description: Accounting code of the company (or `null` if the accounting code should not be updated).

AdditionalTaxIdentifier.title: String update value
AdditionalTaxIdentifier.description: Additional tax identifier of the company (or `null` if the additional tax identifier should not be updated).

BillingCode.title: String update value
BillingCode.description: Billing code of the company (or `null` if the billing code should not be updated).

Contact.title: String update value
Contact.description: Other contact details, such as telephone, email or similar (or `null` if the contact should not be updated).

ContactPerson.title: String update value
ContactPerson.description: Contact person of the company (or `null` if the contact person should not be updated).

Identifier.title: String update value
Identifier.description: Fiscal or legal identifier of the company (or `null` if the identifier should not be updated).

Iata.title: String update value
Iata.description: Iata of the company (or `null` if the Iata should not be updated).

Notes.title: String update value
Notes.description: Notes of the company (or `null` if the notes should not be updated).

TaxIdentifier.title: String update value
TaxIdentifier.description: Tax identification number of the company (or `null` if the tax identifier should not be updated).

Telephone.title: String update value
Telephone.description: Contact telephone number (or `null` if the telephone number should not be updated).

ExternalIdentifier.title: String update value
ExternalIdentifier.description: Identifier of the company from external system (or `null` if the External Identifier should not be updated).
